In short

Holiday team building that gives back turns your company holiday party into a give-back event: your people build something real — holiday gift packages, bikes, skateboards or shoes — that is donated to children and families who need a brighter season, and the recipients come onsite to receive it. Legendary Team Building’s most-booked holiday program is Operation You Matter’s Merry mission, with the charity bike build close behind. For groups of 5 to 5,000, since 2003. It’s the rare holiday event that bonds the team and produces a measurable CSR impact you can put in a year-end report. This is the seasonal program within our charity & CSR team building.

Book early

November and December dates fill first. Holiday give-back events are our most-requested season, and the best dates go four to twelve weeks out. If you’re planning a December holiday party, an end-of-year all-hands or a January kickoff, tell us your date now and we’ll hold it.

How a holiday give-back works

  1. Pick your date early. November and December fill first; tell us your holiday party or all-hands date and we’ll hold it.
  2. Choose the cause. You choose the cause with us, and Legendary Team Building selects, vets and confirms the local recipient organization before the event, such as a Boys & Girls Club.
  3. Build something real. Your team packs holiday gifts or builds bikes, skateboards or shoes, in a program that usually runs 60 to 180 minutes — right inside your holiday event.
  4. The handoff. The children come onsite to receive what your team made. That reveal is the moment of the party.
  5. Report the impact. You receive participation numbers and donation totals for year-end CSR and ESG reporting.
The reason it sticks

The gift your people remember longer than any bonus.

Trade the forgettable dinner for a holiday moment that means something. We’ve run give-back events since 2003 and produced the Guinness World Record–setting charity bike build for our client DaVita. The holidays are when it lands hardest.

Questions, answered

Holiday give-back FAQs

What is a good company holiday party activity that gives back? +

Legendary Team Building’s most-booked holiday give-back is Operation You Matter’s Merry mission: teams pack holiday gifts and cheer for kids and families who need a brighter season, for groups of 5 to 5,000. A charity bike build is the other holiday favorite. Programs run $75 to $175 per person with the donation included. Book four to twelve weeks ahead, because November and December dates fill early.

What’s the best holiday team building for a large group or conference? +

For large groups and year-end conferences, a charity bike build (Building a Dream) or Operation You Matter’s Merry mission scales from 5 to 5,000 people in a single general session. Both end with recipients onsite, so even a 2,000-person ballroom shares one emotional moment. Legendary Team Building produced the 2017 Guinness World Record–setting charity bike build for DaVita with 5,000 employees at once.

How far in advance should we book a holiday give-back event? +

Four to twelve weeks is ideal, and sooner is better for December. The holidays are our busiest give-back season, so the best November and December dates go first. If you already know your holiday party or all-hands date, tell us now and we’ll hold it.

How much does a holiday give-back event cost? +

Legendary Team Building’s holiday give-back programs run $75 to $225 per person, including facilitation, all materials, the donation, and bringing the recipients onsite. Operation You Matter’s Merry mission and a charity bike build typically fall in the $75 to $175 range. Groups over 1,000 are custom-priced.

Can we run a holiday give-back virtually or hybrid? +

Yes. We run virtual and hybrid give-back events so remote teammates build and give alongside everyone in the room. Kits ship to home participants, and the handoff is shared on screen so the whole company feels the moment together.

What gets donated at a holiday event, and who receives it? +

Your team builds real holiday gifts, bikes, skateboards or shoes that are donated to children and families through a vetted local partner — often with the kids onsite to receive them. Boys & Girls Clubs are Legendary Team Building’s #1 recipient partner. We coordinate the charity partnership for you.

Can a holiday event support our year-end CSR and ESG reporting? +

Yes. We provide the participation numbers and donation totals you need, packaged into an ESG-ready impact report, so your holiday party doubles as documented Q4 community impact.
